statement: For every current authoritative readiness planning generation, the ReadinessPlanningSnapshotOwner either publishes a completed snapshot for that generation or explicitly supersedes it with a newer generation, so continuous source churn never leaves its consumers (the critical-topology settling gate and routing readiness) indefinitely served by planning_snapshot_refresh_pending. The planning owner holds the single definition of generation currency (generation/token, rebuild admission, completed snapshot, completed-snapshot reuse, supersession); consumers never decide freshness themselves and callers never mint planning generations. Invariants: (SAFETY) a completed snapshot is never reused after a semantic dependency of its generation changed — a mutation that ignores generation mismatches must red; (LIVENESS) if the authoritative planning state stops changing at generation G then, within bounded owner work and without any wall-clock timeout as the bound, the completed snapshot's generation == G and planning_snapshot_refresh_pending clears; (SUPERSESSION) during continuing churn each obsolete build may be superseded, but the owner mints no additional semantic generation without an authoritative cause — a mutation that rotates the generation continuously must red; (OWNERSHIP) the topology settling gate and routing consume the owner's readiness contract and do not independently judge snapshot freshness; (ENGAGEMENT) under production-shaped post-formation churn on the seed (five nodes, moving clock) the seed's own completed snapshot becomes and stays reusable between authoritative changes, with a red-on-revert proof; (LIVE) on the local docker formation fixture the seed's critical-topology settling gate stops reporting node_ready_lease_incomplete for nodes whose readiness facts are unchanged, and routing no longer reports all_services_filtered_by_readiness for the seed, against the 601x / 175x settle-waits measured on GCP e9774db2e and locally. Scope owns ONLY the ReadinessPlanningSnapshotOwner generation/admission/reuse contract and its single clock-domain input for generation semantics; it does NOT own the critical placement planner, storage_reservation_reconcile, the projection-readiness evidence owner (A3, closed), routing policy, or the settling gate's consumption policy.
